welcome_body: Download authorized content, convert files and create ZIPs safely.
url_hint: Paste HTTP or HTTPS links to content you are authorized to download.
media_notice: Video: remux without re-encoding; incompatible combinations fail safely. Use the converter to transcode. FLAC/WAV cannot restore lost quality. Codec preference does not guarantee availability.
zip_notice: Video and audio compress poorly. ZIPs are verified before publication. In ZIP-only mode, staging files are removed only after verification.
title: Title
playlist_question: This link contains a playlist. Analyze the entire list?
playlist_hint: Analyze a playlist in New download. Pagination loads up to 100 items at a time. Unavailable items are skipped; the others continue.
queue_notice: Cancel stops the job; Retry reuses partial files only if supported by the source. A recovered queue waits for Start queue.
duplicate: Possible duplicate: URL already exists in history.
convert_notice: Drag local files onto this page. Re-encoding may reduce quality. Remux depends on source codecs; fast cuts follow keyframes. URL cutting is not available in this version.
schedule_notice: Runs while the app is open. After sleep, runs one missed occurrence on return. Repeats use 24h/7-day UTC intervals; local time may change with daylight saving. Does not wake the PC or run when closed.
update_notice: Update using an installer from a trusted source. Check the signature and hash published by the distributor. This version does not execute remote updates. Some sites require JavaScript (Deno) and may restrict access.
select_files: Select at least one file or item.
invalid_url: Invalid URL. Use HTTP/HTTPS with no credentials in the link or query.
invalid_options: Invalid options. Check fields and profile.
invalid_time: Invalid times. Use hh:mm:ss, with end after start and within duration.
dependency_missing: Missing dependency. Check FFmpeg/FFprobe in Settings.
dependency_invalid: The selected executable was not recognized as a valid dependency.
media_invalid: Could not inspect media. Check the file and FFprobe.
conversion_failed: Conversion failed. Check codecs/container and free space. The original was preserved.
incompatible_container: Incompatible combination. Choose another format or use transcoding.
no_output: No file was generated. Check formats and subtitle languages.
unavailable: Content removed, unavailable or restricted. Check the link at its source.
private_media: Private content or authentication required. This version does not import credentials.
unsupported_url: This link is not supported by the current yt-dlp version.
network_error: Network error. Check your connection and retry.
format_unavailable: Format unavailable. Analyze again and choose an existing stream.
operation_failed: Operation failed. Check permissions, dependencies, format and disk space.
zip_integrity: ZIP verification failed. Originals were preserved.
invalid_files: Invalid file selection. Avoid symbolic links and missing files.
close_active: Tasks are active. Choose to continue in background, cancel and exit, or go back.
confirm_delete: Remove selected entries? Files will not be deleted.
confirm_sources: Originals will be removed only after ZIP verification. Continue?
about_body: Ytdlp-G 1.0.0 — downloads and media tools. Use authorized content only. No DRM or access-control bypass. MIT software; dependencies retain their licenses. This development build is unsigned. See README and docs/FEATURE_MATRIX.md for limits and validation.
help_body: 1. Paste a link and click Analyze. 2. Choose a profile and folder. 3. Click Download and follow the Queue. For playlists, select items on the Playlists page. Use Library to open results and export selections to ZIP. Converter works with local files. Schedules run while the app is open. Cancellation preserves partials when possible, but resuming is not guaranteed.
no_more: End of page. No new items returned.
schedule_options: Uses current New download options, captured when the schedule is created.
already_running: Ytdlp-G is already running. Check its window or the system tray.
cleanup_warning: Remove temporary and partial downloads from destination folders? Those partials will no longer be resumable. Final files will be preserved.
lite_url_hint: Paste a video or playlist link
lite_instruction: Paste a link and click Analyze.
lite_available_notice: Available qualities only. Playlists show options shared by all accessible items.
lite_choose_quality: Choose a quality and click Download.
lite_no_kind: No available options for this content type.
lite_close_active: Cancel and close? Downloaded files will be preserved.
lite_no_common: No quality is shared by all items. Download the links separately.
lite_mp3_hint: Downloads the best available audio and converts it to MP3 at 320 kbps. Existing MP3 audio is preserved to avoid further loss. Conversion does not improve the source.
